package_entitlements_value_check.name: package_entitlements_value_check
package_entitlements_value_check.value: ("package_entitlements"."is_unlimited" = true AND "package_entitlements"."numeric_value" IS NULL AND "package_entitlements"."boolean_value" IS NULL) OR ("package_entitlements"."is_unlimited" = false AND num_nonnulls("package_entitlements"."numeric_value", "package_entitlements"."boolean_value") = 1)

offers_coupon_code_unique.name: offers_coupon_code_unique
offers_coupon_code_unique.where: "offers"."coupon_code" IS NOT NULL AND "offers"."deleted_at" IS NULL

offers_discount_value_check.name: offers_discount_value_check
offers_discount_value_check.value: ("offers"."discount_type" = 'percentage' AND "offers"."percentage_basis_points" > 0 AND "offers"."percentage_basis_points" <= 10000 AND "offers"."fixed_amount_minor" IS NULL) OR ("offers"."discount_type" = 'fixed' AND "offers"."fixed_amount_minor" > 0 AND "offers"."percentage_basis_points" IS NULL)

offers_period_check.name: offers_period_check
offers_period_check.value: "offers"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "offers"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "offers"."ends_at" > "offers"."starts_at"

package_prices_current_public_unique.name: package_prices_current_public_unique
package_prices_current_public_unique.where: "package_prices"."is_active" = true AND "package_prices"."is_public" = true AND "package_prices"."deleted_at" IS NULL

packages_trial_configuration_check.name: packages_trial_configuration_check
packages_trial_configuration_check.value: ("packages"."trial_enabled" = false AND "packages"."trial_duration" IS NULL AND "packages"."trial_duration_unit" IS NULL) OR ("packages"."trial_enabled" = true AND "packages"."trial_duration" > 0 AND "packages"."trial_duration_unit" IS NOT NULL)

application_builds_completion_check.name: application_builds_completion_check
application_builds_completion_check.value: "application_builds"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "application_builds"."started_at" IS NOT NULL

database_backups_completion_check.name: database_backups_completion_check
database_backups_completion_check.value: "database_backups"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "database_backups"."started_at" IS NOT NULL

database_clusters_management_endpoint_ch.name: database_clusters_management_endpoint_check
database_clusters_management_endpoint_ch.value: ("database_clusters"."management_host" IS NULL AND "database_clusters"."management_port" IS NULL) OR ("database_clusters"."management_host" IS NOT NULL AND "database_clusters"."management_port" IS NOT NULL)

logical_databases_resource_active_unique.name: logical_databases_resource_active_unique
logical_databases_resource_active_unique.where: "logical_databases"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL AND "logical_databases"."deleted_at" IS NULL

application_cron_jobs_provider_uuid_acti.name: application_cron_jobs_provider_uuid_active_unique
application_cron_jobs_provider_uuid_acti.where: "application_cron_jobs"."provider_task_uuid" IS NOT NULL AND "application_cron_jobs"."deleted_at" IS NULL

workspace_memberships_ownership_dates_ch.name: workspace_memberships_ownership_dates_check
workspace_memberships_ownership_dates_ch.value: "workspace_memberships"."ownership_ended_at" IS NULL OR "workspace_memberships"."ownership_started_at" IS NOT NULL

customer_checkouts_quote_id_unique.name: customer_checkouts_quote_id_unique
customer_checkouts_quote_id_unique.where: "customer_checkouts"."quote_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_checkouts"."deleted_at" IS NULL

workspace_subscriptions_primary_active_u.name: workspace_subscriptions_primary_active_unique
workspace_subscriptions_primary_active_u.where: "workspace_subscriptions"."is_primary" = true AND "workspace_subscriptions"."status" IN ('trialing', 'active') AND "workspace_subscriptions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

workspace_entitlement_overrides_value_ch.name: workspace_entitlement_overrides_value_check
workspace_entitlement_overrides_value_ch.value: ("workspace_entitlement_overrides"."is_unlimited" = true AND "workspace_entitlement_overrides"."numeric_value" IS NULL AND "workspace_entitlement_overrides"."boolean_value" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_entitlement_overrides"."is_unlimited" = false AND num_nonnulls("workspace_entitlement_overrides"."numeric_value", "workspace_entitlement_overrides"."boolean_value") = 1)

workspace_usage_observations_period_chec.name: workspace_usage_observations_period_check
workspace_usage_observations_period_chec.value: "workspace_usage_observations"."period_end" IS NULL OR "workspace_usage_observations"."period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_usage_observations"."period_end" > "workspace_usage_observations"."period_start"
